semiconductor_relevance: High — Adenso specializes in modular robotic solutions and implanter equipment specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Adenso Industrial Services GmbH develops and supplies modular robotic solutions for high-vacuum environments, particularly in semiconductor and fine optics applications. Their VAC.ROBOTICS platform allows for the easy configuration of complex cluster systems, enhancing production efficiency with integrated pre- and post-process capabilities.
capabilities: Modular robotic solutions for high-vacuum environments
Implanter modules for SiC superjunction technologies
High-volume manufacturing solutions with substrate heating up to 1,000°C
